pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

pages.title: The bridge in the fog · 1/3
paragraphs: It is seven in the morning in San Francisco. A thick fog covers the streets and the hills. Alex steps outside with a cup of coffee. He cannot see the end of the street. His neighbor Pat waters the plants by her door. She waves and calls his name.
“Good morning, Alex! It is so foggy today.” says Pat. “I know. I cannot see the bridge.” says Alex. “It is always like this in the morning.” says Pat.

pages.title: The bridge in the fog · 3/3
paragraphs: “Is the afternoon better?” says Alex. “Yes, it is usually sunny after twelve.” says Pat. Alex goes back inside and takes a sweater. He walks to work in the cool, white air. Around noon, the fog starts to lift. The sun comes out and the bridge appears. At lunch, he eats outside with his jacket on. Every kind of weather has its own beauty.
